items.source: It is assumed that both instances have been obtained via getMatchingCondition(Message) to ensure they contain only patterns that match the request and are sorted with the best matches on top.
items.translation: 假定这两个实例均通过 `getMatchingCondition(Message)` 获取，以确保它们仅包含与请求匹配的模式，且最佳匹配项排在最前。

items.source: Non-empty patterns that don't start with "/" are prepended with "/".
items.translation: 不以"/"开头的非空模式前面会加上"/"。

items.source:
Returns a new instance with URL patterns from the current instance ("this") and the "other" instance as follows:
  • If there are patterns in both instances, combine the patterns in "this" with the patterns in "other" using PathMatcher.combine(String, String).
  • If only one instance has patterns, use them.
  • If neither instance has patterns, use an empty String (i.e. "").
items.translation:
返回一个新实例，该实例包含当前实例（"this"）和"other"实例中的 URL 模式，具体方式如下：
  • 如果两个实例都包含模式，则使用 PathMatcher.combine(String, String) 将 "this" 中的模式与 "other" 中的模式组合。
  • 如果只有一个实例包含模式，则使用该模式。
  • 如果两个实例都不包含模式，则使用空字符串（即 ""）。
